messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty p12345678 fired -> service=canary-inference, symptom=streaming proxy 5xx surge (>3% sustained 4m). Runbook: /runbooks/canary-regressions

pagerduty-bot: Alert triggered and paging team oncall (alex)

alex: acked. I'll take initial triage. pinging infra.

maria: I'm seeing the same in traces. Canary fraction was increased to 15% at 01:08 UTC. Error spike started ~01:12 and peaked ~01:15. Most errors are 502 from proxy to runtime; lots of retries.

kevin: logs show repeated KV cache thrash + "upstream cancel" messages. Dumping a few samples below.

kevin: ```
[proxy] upstream canceled: context deadline exceeded id=xyz789
[runtime] kvcache: miss, key=seq-4096
[kernel] runtime panic: bad kernel index
```

jordan: quick customer-impact estimate: currently looks limited to canary traffic but retry amplification pushed a small amount (0.8%) of total traffic into higher tail latency. A couple of high-throughput customers on streaming endpoints may see failures.

samir: immediate mitigation options: 1) scale canary to zero, 2) flip traffic to stable, 3) toggle ff quant_q4_enabled=false. Which is fastest?

alex: flip traffic first (least disruptive). Use traffic-controller apply so we can roll back quickly.

alex: ```
redwood-traffic apply --route canary-inference --weights stable:100,canary:0 --env prod --reason "canary 5xx spike"
```

maria: applied weights. Controller response: update accepted. Watching metrics.

ops-bot: Traffic update accepted -> stable=100, canary=0 (req_id=rt-5566)

maria: within 90s the proxy 5xx rate dropped to baseline on prod. Good signal.

kevin: reproducer notes: the q4 quant path selects an alternated kernel for block sizes > 1024; under certain sequence patterns this leads to incorrect mem access and upstream timeouts. I can repro in staging with long streaming prompts.

jordan: customer update: errors returned to baseline by 01:18 UTC after flip. Still watching. Logging a short note to status page.

samir: while it's cooling, I recommend disabling the q4 flag and keeping canary paused. If we need a quick rollback of the binary, do we have a pinned stable image?

kevin: yes stable image tag r2026-21 is pinned. We should rollback the canary revision in k8s and revoke the feature flag. Steps:

kevin: ```
# rollback deployment revision to last stable
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/canary-runtime --to-revision=7
# disable ff
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://flags.internal/api/toggle -d '{"flag":"quant_q4_enabled","value":false}'
```

maria: started rollout undo now. Pods re-creating, healthchecks passing. Linking aggregated logs: https://logs.redwood/internal/streams/3223344555

alex: good. Also bump proxy upstream timeout to reduce immediate 504 amplification while we investigate (temporary). Samir can you apply and then revert later?

samir: applying proxy change: increased upstream timeout from 10s -> 25s in prod proxy pool. Pushing via ops change: 

samir: ```
opsctl update proxy-config --upstream-timeout=25s --pool=prod-streaming
```

ops-bot: Proxy config change applied (change-id=pc-3223). Note: this is a temporary mitigation; revert once QA signs off.

jordan: monitoring update: error rate stable; p99 latency for streaming endpoints dropped back near normal. Customer impact estimate: <1% of customers experienced transient failures; major ingestion pipelines unaffected.

kevin: root cause hypothesis: opportunistic kernel selection in q4 quant path + specific tokenization patterns led to untested execution path. I'll produce a patch to guard kernel selection and add a unit test for long-sequence streaming cases.

alex: escalation plan: if 5xx rate climbs above 1% again within next 45m, escalate to oncall-eng PD rotation and open bridge. For now mark incident mitigated and enable 1h watch.

incident-bot: Incident p12345678 marked mitigated -> monitoring. Autowatch enabled for 60m. Severity downgraded to P2.

maria: filing incident ticket INC-2026-3223344555 with timeline, logs, and links. Assigning to kevin for root cause and to samir for ops rollback plan.

kevin: creating follow-up task: PROJ-8991 reproducer + test harness; I'll queue a patch to disable the risky kernel code path behind flag until validated. Uploading repro: https://ci.redwood/repros/3223344555

samir: ops action: will revert proxy timeout bump after fix is validated. Noted.

alex: handoff: I'm on duty for another 45m. After that @kevin will be primary. Please coordinate and get a small postmortem in the tracker; include mitigation timeline and regression test.

jordan: I'm drafting a short status-page update: "Investigating a canary regression affecting a subset of streaming requests; mitigation in place and rollback completed. Full postmortem to follow." Posting to #customer-success draft.

pagerduty-bot: Status update: p12345678 -> mitigated. Owner transferred alex -> kevin.

kevin: ack. I'll keep the monitoring window and alert if anything resurfaces. Planning to disable the q4 kernel selection flag in staging and run a 2h soak before re-enabling canary deployments.

incident-bot: Thread archived. Reopen on new alerts or if autowatch triggers."
